# EnKash Checkout

Integrate one SDK from this index. Each page below is complete: an integration model that receives only that file can implement that SDK. The merchant server creates the order. Every page starts from an existing `order_id`. There is no order-create call in these SDKs. Standard, Quick, and Custom Checkout take the merchant access key when checkout is opened. The outcome is the handler. It is not a browser redirect to a callback URL. The handler payload is not proof of payment. The merchant server confirms the transaction with EnKash, server to server, before fulfilling the order.

Pick the SDK by who renders checkout and how the outcome comes back.

<CardGroup cols={2}>
  <Card title="Standard Checkout" icon="material-two-tone-storefront">
    The merchant page opens EnKash hosted checkout in an iframe. The outcome is the `handler` callback. Voluntary close is `modal.ondismiss`, which is not a payment result.

    File: `standard-checkout.md`
  </Card>
  <Card title="Quick Checkout" icon="material-two-tone-business_center">
    The merchant page adds one element and one script. EnKash injects the Pay button. The outcome is `EnkashQuickCheckout.handler`.

    File: `quick-checkout.md`
  </Card>
  <Card title="React Native" icon="material-two-tone-cottage">
    A React Native app opens the same hosted checkout in a WebView. `EnKashCheckout.open` resolves once with `{ kind: 'result', payload }` or `{ kind: 'dismiss' }`.

    File: `react-native.md`
  </Card>
  <Card title="Custom Checkout" icon="material-two-tone-corporate_fare">
    The merchant renders the checkout UI. `EnkashCustomCheckout` calls the gateway and opens the bank popup. Every terminal outcome is the `handler` callback, at most once.

    File: `custom-checkout.md`
  </Card>
</CardGroup>

| File | Global | Outcome channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `standard-checkout.md` | `EnkashCheckout` | `handler(payload)` |
| `quick-checkout.md` | `EnkashQuickCheckout` | `handler(payload)` |
| `react-native.md` | `EnKashCheckout` | `open()` promise, and optional `handler` |
| `custom-checkout.md` | `EnkashCustomCheckout` | `handler(payload)` once |
